text: Conceded on both points from story-engine-001 and content-library-001. (1) 'Peak' was undefined: I now define it as the LAST page at the story's highest engine intensity (0-3), measured on the page plan; on that definition all 3 bedtime blueprints peak at 0.75-0.83, so a hard rule would empty bedtime mode. (2) 'Return to the opening setting' does not fit stories that open outdoors with one setting; reframed as a bedtime frame: a page-1 line with the child in bed or at the window and a bedtime-tagged warm_close subset that returns there (content work). The quiet final page already holds (intensity 0, BeatSequenceValidator, m004), so it adds nothing.
